title: e2e property oracle stricter than the product+fast-suite omp tolerances (release campaign found)
description: Full: the e2e TUI property suite (test/e2e/tui.property.test.js) asserted plain subsequence soundness while the product ships omp exact-port tolerances (one adjacent letter/digit swap; a token may overshoot a word by up to two trailing chars — lib/fuzzy.js prefix-extension + swaps; the fast oracle soundlyMatches already documents these). Campaign seeds tripped it: FC_SEED=20261014 counterexample [end,up,home,escape,clear,down,1,z] msg "row mock/mock-gamma-1-5 matches query tokens (soundness)"; FC_SEED=20261015 counterexample [home,hopPrev,e,1,up,z,down,space] q="e1". Suite bug, NOT product bug: aligned the e2e oracle with the fast documented one (soundlyMatches with swaps + 2-char overshoot), SPEC P-05 wording updated to the tolerance-aware acceptance.
close_reason: Suite-oracle bug (not a product bug), found by the release-scale TUI campaign: the e2e soundness oracle asserted plain subsequence while lib/fuzzy.js (ported from omp, kept behavior-identical) accepts one adjacent letter/digit swap and a <=2-char token overshoot past a word; the fast suite oracle soundlyMatches (test/selector.property.test.js) already documented these tolerances. Red evidence: FC_SEED=20261014 counterexample [end,up,home,escape,clear,down,1,z] ("row mock/mock-gamma-1-5 matches query tokens (soundness)", path 1) and FC_SEED=20261015 counterexample [home,hopPrev,e,1,up,z,down,space] q="e1" (campaign logs at test/.artifacts/campaign/tui-seed-*.log). Fix commit dd4909f: e2e oracle aligned (soundlyMatches with swaps + overshoot), header + SPEC P-05 wording updated. Green: seed 20261014 launch group re-run 40/40 pass (repair-check log).

title: Two TUIs writing model-stars.json race / lose updates
description: Concurrent toggles from two dsh-TUI processes sharing ~/.dsh-tui: a scene's in-memory set goes stale and a toggle can resurrect/drop the other process's stars; tmp file name only pid-unique.
acceptance_criteria: Spec-defined merge policy (read-modify-write per toggle, re-read on open/toggle); test with two writers; red then fix if it fails.
notes: STEP-0 closure audit REOPEN (round 3): closed with a documented deferred residual (cross-process RMW window). Real bug still reachable: two dsh-TUI processes toggling in the same instant lose one star. Reproduced by test/concurrent-toggle.test.js red run: lost updates in 4/60 inter-process races (round 8 kept only mock/alpha, both children exit 0 saved:true) + stale .lock after a killed process is never reclaimed. Fixing with cross-process file locking before re-close.
close_reason: REOPENED (round-3 closure audit: closed state deferred a real bug) -> FIXED. Red e05cba9: test/concurrent-toggle.test.js drove production toggleStar from two real child processes; 4/60 same-tick races lost one star (both children exit 0 saved:true, final file kept only one ref); stale .lock from a killed process never reclaimed. Fix: exclusive lock file around each read-modify-write (LOCK_RETRY 15 ms, live-contention timeout 1.5 s -> falls back to the persisted-state warning semantics of P-23), stale locks (>10 s) stolen. Fix verification: concurrency suite 2/2 pass (60/60 rounds keep both stars; stale lock stolen+removed; no .lock left); write-failure full suite green 5/5 incl. the scene-level merge policy; full fast suites green (verify runs in bg under co-tenant load). Residual documented: model-recents.json is also written by dsh-TUI itself without the plugin lock (out of this bead; plugin side unchanged best-effort).

title: toggleStar ignores a failed stars-file write
description: lib/store.js toggleStar returns the toggled set even when writeRefs fails, so the UI shows a star that was never persisted (lost on restart).
acceptance_criteria: When the stars file cannot be written, the scene shows the persisted state (no phantom star) and tells the user; red test then fix.
close_reason: red b273cbe (test/write-failure.test.js: phantom star + no warning on unwritable starsFile; assertion-level red re-proven against pre-fix lib) -> fix 971f076: toggleStar returns {stars: persisted, saved:false} on write failure and the scene reverts the row and shows a warning; recovery of the scene verified; full fast suite 33/33 green
